text: Chloe Veitch, born on 6 March 1999, is an English model, media personality, and beauty queen who won Miss Supertalent 2018. She is best known for her roles in Too Hot To Handle (2020), The Circle (2021), and Perfect Match (2023). Veitch also appeared on Channel 4's Celebrity Ghost Trip (2021), where she was paired with Too Hot To Handle co-star Nicole O'Brien, and on Celebrity Hunted (2022). She was a joint winner of Netflix's first series of Too Hot To Handle and was voted runner-up while winning the "Fan Favorite" award in the second season of The Circle. Veitch grew up in Clacton-on-Sea, Essex, and attended Clacton Coastal Academy. Prior to her television appearances, she worked as an estate agent and model. She currently resides in London and has indicated her intention to move to the United States of America for work. Veitch is openly bisexual.
